`homework-synthetic.heic` is a synthetic 160 × 120 image generated locally with
Pillow and pillow-heif. It contains only “SYNTHETIC TEST”, “12 + 23 = 35” and
“Page 49”. No student data, camera metadata or third-party photograph is included.
It verifies real HEIC decoding and JPEG previews, rather than a spoofed MIME type.
